senses.gloss: m. (corrupt. of primipilum, v. Perl. Beitr., p. 11) the office of the chief Centurio of the troop called Triarii, primipilate.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:1">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>לקיטרון … שימש פ׳ שלו וכ׳</he> like a Centurio who had served his term but failed to enter his primipilate (to which he would have been promoted in due time), but fled &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 631">Yalk. Lev. 631</cite> <cite ref="Q00231"><he>פולימרכוס</he></cite> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 178:2">Yalk. Ex. 178</cite> <he>פלומי פילון</he> (corr. acc).
